title: Mirror fast-weight programmer context code

random_selection.live_conflict_check: git fetch origin --prune; no remote MA-288 branch found

hypothesis: Four context-dependent fast memories related by Givens conjugation can be represented by one physical fast-weight matrix plus one dynamic session angle, while unrelated contexts require private memory state.
mirror_coordinate: One dynamic float32 Givens angle supplied by each session cue
controls: ordinary shared FWP without context code
per-session rank-r residual over base memory
stream: Four sessions; each session receives eight one-hot key/value writes to a fast-weight matrix using the delta rule. Context cues supply continuous angles. Aligned session teachers are W_c=R(m_c) W_0 R(m_c)^T. Independent teachers are unrelated random matrices and cues do not encode their function.

development.selection_metric: mean held-out output MSE across methods and aligned/independent conditions

storage.codec: deterministic binary tensor records charging field names, context codes/IDs, dtype, shape, learned state and headers

success_gate: On all three fresh aligned worlds, Mirror output MSE <=1e-5, actual total state <=0.5x independent per-session FWP, and coordinate-path inference throughput >=0.5x selected low-rank residual control. Mirror-specific value also requires a better quality/byte/compute frontier than both one-scalar FiLM and selected low-rank residual control.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any aligned quality/storage/runtime gate or is Pareto-dominated by FiLM or a low-rank residual control.
boundaries: Not a realistic long-stream or Transformer result

amendments.change: Set the independent condition base memory equal to session 0, matching the registered shared slow/base memory learned from the first context; freeze residual rank 4 selected on corrected development worlds.
amendments.reason: An initial development implementation sampled an extra unused base matrix for independent worlds, contrary to the protocol statement that session 0 establishes the shared base. Those development tables are retained invalidated. Recomputed development score selected rank 4 (mean held-out MSE 0.079991; rank 2: 0.085457; rank 1: 0.091619).
